verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of scheduled tasks, either one-off or recurring, that run automatically and return results. Grok Bot is described only as handing work to AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer, with no scheduling. The 'service_tier: priority' item concerns request scheduling priority, an unrelated inference setting, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results
